parameters.content:
## formsflow application record
'Create Application Record' registers each new payment submission with POST {FORMSFLOW_API_URL}/application/create, as Camunda's ExternalSubmissionListener did. The request-management API creates the Form.io submission but does not do this, so it stays here.

It is best effort: if the token or the call fails, the payment carries on. A replay that reuses a stored submission does not register it again.

FORMIO_URL (Set Process Vars) is only used to build the formUrl sent in this call; n8n holds no Form.io login. In foi-initial-payment-submission.bpmn the returned applicationId is not read by any later step.

## Developer Overview – FOI Fee Initiation

**Purpose:**
Creates the applicant's online fee payment for a request (feeAction = initiate).

**Trigger/Entry:**
Sub-workflow called by **FOI Fee Processing** (router). Start node has fixed fields, so it can also be run on its own with a foi-fee-payment item (see the Start node note). `Set Event Variables` normalises the fields.

**Processing:**
Get payment details. If balance due > 0, the applicant has an email and payment is not offline: register (or reuse) a PENDING row in `foi-payment-sla`, create the payment submission through the API, register it as a formsflow application (best effort), store its ids and payment URL on that row, save the payment URL and expiry date, notify the applicant, then promote the row to ACTIVE if it is still PENDING. A replay reuses the stored ids instead of creating a second submission; a row cancelled while PENDING is not promoted. Otherwise audit "no online payment".

**Integration/Outcome:**
Calls FOI Backend API Manager (payonline, foipayment-formsubmission-create, foipayment-save), the formsflow API (/application/create) and FOI Email Processing. n8n does not log in to Form.io. Uses `foi-payment-sla` and `foi-process-audit` (process_type = fee-process).

nodes.name: Create Payment Form Submission
nodes.notes: Creates the applicant's payment submission through FOI Backend API Manager. Returns formId, submissionId and paymentUrl. NOT idempotent: never turn on retries; a replay reuses the ids stored on the PENDING SLA row.

nodes.name: FOI-OIDC
nodes.notes: Token for the formsflow API. On failure the application record is skipped; the payment still continues.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ formUrl: $('Set Process Vars').first().json.FORMIO_URL + '/form/' + $('Create Payment Form Submission').first().json.formId + '/submission/' + $('Create Payment Form Submission').first().json.submissionId, formId: $('Create Payment Form Submission').first().json.formId, submissionId: $('Create Payment Form Submission').first().json.submissionId, processInstanceId: $execution.id }) }}

nodes.name: Create Application Record
nodes.notes: Why HTTP: no node for the formsflow API. Registers the new submission as a formsflow application (as Camunda's ExternalSubmissionListener did). The request-management API does not do this. Best effort: a failure does not stop the payment.
